content: Hyperparameters used for our agents are given below. Patience and buffer size are used for the policy chaining method as described in Section SECREF2. Cell step size is a parameter used for Go-Explore and describes how many steps are taken when exploring in a given cell state. Base hyperparameters for KG-A2C are taken from BIBREF6 and the same parameters are used for A2C.
